name: rampaging_baloths_two_lands_at_once_two_beasts
notes: M6 mapper. Printed: 'Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, create a 4/4 green Beast creature token.' Support card: FDN Grow from the Ashes (mapped; kicked: 'search your library for two basic land cards, put them onto the battlefield'). The Forest and the Island enter at the same time: each is a land entering, so landfall triggers twice (once per land, not once for the event): seat 0 gets two Beast tokens. The library holds just the two basics, so the search takes both; the one decision orders the two triggers.
